source_cause: The production column actors are cached in NoteField.__songlua_note_columns, outside its sequence children. The compiled screen update plan traverses wrappers, sequence children and the special song-meter stream but never traverses the owned column renderer cache. Thus column tweens are appended by ShowArrow/HideArrow/RandomLocation/ReturnLocation and never receive elapsed time. Native NoteField.Update first runs ActorFrame.Update then explicitly updates every m_ColumnRenderers[c] with the NoteField delta.
changes: Own the complete native style column vector when the NoteField is created, and invalidate the cached update plan when a column cache is first materialized.

Schedule column Actor updates after the NoteField ActorFrame callback. Separate children, wrappers and NoteField columns as native delta sources: columns receive the original field input before field hibernation or update-rate scaling; skipped ancestors still suppress them.
regression_control: The real owned NoteField advances once; column lookup aliases remain stable and the separate vector does not alter ActorFrame child count. A real column linear tween advances time and authored X pose; zero delta preserves it. A field callback reads the column before column advancement. The field rate does not scale columns or their wrappers; field hibernation leaves the vector active; ancestor hibernation and its wake overshoot gate the field; ancestor rate reaches columns; column hibernation gates its wrappers. The tween and its native lowercase addcommand queue complete once.

initial_control_correction.cause: Version1 used the wrong Lua casing AddCommand and failed before the timer assertion. Native and production Lua expose addcommand. Version2 corrected that test typo and sets an explicit authored starting X rather than relying on a default column pose. No production code changed for this correction.
